data.narrative:
Askari Defense operates in the Defense & Security sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private competitors, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. The broader sector contains 26 same-sector peers.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security peer set, while substantial in absolute terms at 26 companies, lacks sufficient depth within narrow stage and valuation-tier filters. No same-stage comparables, adjacent-stage comparables, or similar-tier private companies met the minimum threshold of three datapoints required for reliable peer-median triangulation. Relying on all-sector median multiples would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, technology maturity, and revenue scales across Defense & Security subsectors.

Without applicable triangulation methods, a defensible valuation range cannot be established from the data provided. Resolution of Askari Defense's valuation would require either: (1) disclosure of the company's current stage and financial metrics to enable stage-specific peer filtering, or (2) collection of additional private comparable data within narrowly defined stage and scale cohorts. The public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) provide sector context but insufficient precision for single-company valuation absent revenue or margin data specific to Askari.
